cr_plot_policy: High-dM and low-dM CRs are drawn both as combined overview plots and as individual region plots.

dy_rz_application.factor_policy: channel-specific RZ(Nb); exact for explicit Nb axes and DY-yield-weighted effective factor for inclusive CR distributions

legend_policy: plot-integrated yields are shown for variable distributions; category/search-bin plots remain yield-free
ntop_order: N_t = 0 blocks are placed left of N_t >= 1 blocks.
